hero_eyebrow: Qualified Arborists — Safe Tree Removal & Pruning
hero_subhead: From hazardous limb removal to complete felling — we handle any job safely, on time, and at a fair price.
services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: Whether you need a single branch pruned or a dangerous tree felled, we've got the skills and equipment to do it safely.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe, controlled removal of dead, diseased, or unwanted trees of any size. We handle site clearance and rubbish removal, leaving your garden tidy.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Strategic pruning to reduce weight, improve shape, and encourage healthy growth. Ideal for overgrown trees threatening fences or buildings.

services.title: Limb & Branch Removal
services.desc: Safe removal of dangerous or overhanging branches before they cause damage. We assess risk and remove hazards quickly and affordably.

services.title: Storm Damage Response
services.desc: Emergency callouts for fallen trees and storm damage. We're on standby 24/7 to clear debris and make your property safe again.

services.title: Stump Grinding & Removal
services.desc: Complete stump removal using specialist grinding equipment. The area is left level and ready for replanting or landscaping.

services.title: Tree Health Assessment
services.desc: Professional inspection to identify disease, pest damage, or structural weakness. We advise on treatment options or safe removal.

about_pullquote: We treat every tree with respect and every customer like family.
about_para_1: OD Tree Surgeons was founded on the principle that tree work should be done right — safely, professionally, and without breaking the bank. Over 15 years, we've built our reputation on turning up on time, finishing the job properly, and cleaning up after ourselves. We're fully qualified arborists with public liability insurance and the equipment to handle everything from small garden pruning to major felling work.
about_para_2: Homeowners and businesses across Newcastle trust us because we don't oversell or rush jobs. We'll always give you an honest assessment: sometimes a tree just needs pruning, not removing. That integrity is why customers come back and recommend us to their neighbours. Your garden's safety and the long-term health of your trees matter to us as much as they do to you.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Had a massive oak tree that was dying and threatening the house. OD came out for a free assessment, explained exactly what needed doing and why, then got the job done in a day. Very professional, zero mess left behind. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Storm knocked a huge branch across our driveway. Called OD at 6pm on a Saturday evening and they were here within two hours. Got the mess cleared, made everything safe. Genuinely the best service I've had. Fair price too.
reviews.author: Emma R.

reviews.text: Been using OD for about five years now. Always turn up when they say they will, always chat through the options, and the lads are a pleasure to have around. Just had three trees pruned and the work is immaculate. Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: David H.
